title: Windows layout application with retained effects and recovery

export.title: Windows portable layout export

prefixItems.title: Absolute launch executable
prefixItems.$comment: The authoritative executable plus arguments bound is 30720 UTF-8 bytes and worst-case JSON string-content bytes.

anyOf.$comment: A variadic argv tuple: one absolute executable followed by zero to 128 literal arguments.

export.$comment: Exact primary/child observations preserve unbound start:false members. At most 24 Panels and 16 levels, with 16 children per Panel; total 1 MiB and runtime byte bounds are enforced by the CLI.

geometry.$comment: Semantic validation additionally requires columns * rows <= 262144, columns * cellPixelWidth <= 65535, and rows * cellPixelHeight <= 65535. The cellPixelWidth/cellPixelHeight pair must be either both positive (pixels known) or both zero (pixels unknown); a mixed pair is invalid.
